# data-editor-table

> Integration guide for the React business-data grid. The README and the executable package consumers below track the public interfaces shipped by this repository.

## Start here

- [Quick start](README.md#quick-start) shows the imports, styles, typed columns, document model and a complete React host. Give the viewport a height and keep the data-source instance stable.
- [Data-source and column contract](README.md#data-source-and-column-contract) describes `createRemoteGridDataSource({ source, scope, model, columns, getRowKey, persistence })`. The host implements `PersistenceSource` from `data-editor-table/protocol`. Its reads return complete, versioned snapshots with stable row incarnations and explicit order.
- [Persistence and synchronization](docs/persistence-consistency.md) describes entity-bound operation targets, shared version evidence for snapshots and receipts, and per-table save state. A dispute fences all writers in the physical scope until the host verifies its ledger and calls `resolveDispute`. Attachment starts an authority read. Supply `initialAuthority` to display a complete snapshot already available to the host.
- [Saving and errors](README.md#saving-and-errors) covers manual, immediate and debounced saves. Await `controller.save()` for the actual outcome. Pass the current descriptor to `controller.recoverSave()` and read the next action after review. Use `selectGridActions(snapshot)` for save, retry and recovery availability and their targets and `controller.refresh()` for an explicit read.
- [Advanced React integration](README.md#advanced-integration) covers `useDataGridBinding({ dataSource, initial, effects })`. It returns an attachment with a status and a binding. Render the retained binding during a blocked switch so the user can resolve pending work. Manually owned bindings expose a checked `destroy()` result.
- [Entry points](README.md#entry-points), [custom cell types](README.md#custom-cell-types), [row operations](README.md#row-operations-and-protected-rows) and [messages and theme](README.md#messages-surfaces-and-theme) describe the supported extension interfaces.

## Executable examples

- [Typed package consumer](tests/package-consumer/index.ts) uses the published entry points for columns, document models, source adapters and controllers.
- [React browser consumer](tests/package-consumer/browser/main.tsx) exercises the attachment, a real source, localization and styles in StrictMode.
- [React-free engine consumer](tests/package-consumer/engine-only.ts) demonstrates the headless entry point.
- [IndexedDB demo authority](demo/src/demo-source.ts) implements atomic writes, immutable operation results and fenced lookups. [Demo adapter](demo/src/demo-data-source.ts) binds that authority to the grid.
